step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture illustrates Experian's automated custom ML model onboarding platform. 1. A data scientist uses the UI Portal (ThirdParty) to upload model artifacts (pickle files, dependencies, attributes). 2. UI Portal passes requests to a Platform API running on AWS Fargate (Top). 3. Fargate (Top) creates a entry in OpenSearch (Model Registry), saves artifacts to S3, and emits a build event to MSK. 4. An EC2 instance acting as a build machine consumes the event from MSK, retrieves artifacts from S3, builds a SageMaker-compatible Docker image, pushes it to ECR, and creates/deploys the SageMaker endpoint. 5. SageMaker status events trigger EventBridge, which invokes Lambda to push status notifications back to MSK. 6. A Consumer App running on AWS Fargate (Bottom) consumes the completion event, updates OpenSearch with the endpoint metadata, and notifies the UI Portal.

graph.name: Experian Custom Model Onboarding Platform
graph.notes: Architecture for rapidly onboarding custom client machine learning models at Experian, taking build-to-production time from months to days using MSK, SageMaker, EC2, and Fargate.

nodes.name: UI Portal
nodes.notes: Frontend portal where data scientists upload model artifacts, library dependencies, and attribute files.

nodes.name: AWS Fargate (Platform API)
nodes.notes: Platform API backend that handles initial upload requests, registers models, stores artifacts, and initiates builds.

nodes.name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
nodes.notes: Serves as the model registry datastore for tracking model entries and endpoint metadata.

nodes.name: Amazon S3
nodes.notes: Stores uploaded raw model artifacts, pickle files, and code dependencies.

nodes.name: Amazon MSK
nodes.notes: Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka, orchestrates asynchronous build triggers and deployment status updates.

nodes.name: Amazon EC2
nodes.notes: Build machine running Docker that compiles artifacts into SageMaker-compatible container images.

nodes.name: Amazon ECR
nodes.notes: Container registry storing built Docker images for SageMaker deployment.

nodes.name: Amazon SageMaker
nodes.notes: Provisions managed endpoints, applies auto-scaling policies, and performs ML model inferencing.

nodes.name: Amazon EventBridge
nodes.notes: Monitors SageMaker state changes and emits endpoint status events.

nodes.name: AWS Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes EventBridge status events and posts updates back to Kafka.

nodes.name: AWS Fargate (Consumer App)
nodes.notes: Consumer application processing completion events to update OpenSearch and return deployment status to the UI Portal.

edges.notes: User submits upload request via UI Portal to the Platform API.
Platform API creates an initial entry in the OpenSearch model registry.
Platform API writes uploaded model artifacts to S3.
Platform API emits a build initiation event to an MSK Kafka topic.
MSK event triggers the build process on the EC2 build machine.
EC2 build machine fetches model artifacts from S3.
EC2 builds Docker container image and pushes it to Amazon ECR.
EC2 creates SageMaker endpoint configuration and deploys the model endpoint.
SageMaker emits endpoint status change events to EventBridge.
EventBridge triggers AWS Lambda function upon endpoint state change.
Lambda function writes deployment status notification event to Kafka topic.
MSK triggers the consumer application running on AWS Fargate.
Consumer app updates UI Portal with deployment success/failure status.
Consumer app updates endpoint details in OpenSearch model registry.
